name: codex-auto-retry
description: Automatically resumes Codex tasks after recoverable provider failures, with a Windows tray controller and an embedded Codex panel.

interface.shortDescription: Recover interrupted tasks with tray and Codex controls.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local, provider-independent watchdog that retries failed tasks through Codex App's own background connection without focusing the App or switching tasks. A Windows tray controller and embedded Codex panel show live countdowns, bounded retry attempts, queue state, pause controls, and retry settings.
defaultPrompt: 打开 Codex Auto Retry 管理面板。
查看自动重试队列和倒计时。
把普通对话的重试文字改成“继续”。
